valid_until: Reviewed source bytes or scope change; preserve this review and obtain a new exact review.
scope: Full 570-line runner and 274-line harness source review only; no fixture, native, application or admission execution.

R4-F1.reason: Publication reserves bounded metadata inside unchanged limits; durable outcome writes precede final size/floor/deadline checks and accepted state acknowledgement.

R4-F2.reason: Manifest hash and parse share one byte buffer; on-disk snapshot is rechecked before launch and publication.

R4-F3.reason: Log reads precede signal-masked finalization. Handled/pending signals fail the uncommitted step; campaign flock and pending state remain until coherent final acknowledgement. Explicit postcommit policy retains the defined boundary.

findings.title: Hash and parse each prior receipt from one immutable buffer
findings.evidence: load_prefix compares digest(path) with the stored receipt hash, then separately reads path bytes for json.loads.
findings.failure_trace: A receipt changed between those reads can be copied into the cumulative ledger under its earlier stored hash. Field checks constrain commands/status/baseline, but do not bind all parsed evidence bytes.
findings.required_change: Read receipt_bytes once; compare hashlib.sha256(receipt_bytes).hexdigest() with the stored hash and parse json.loads(receipt_bytes).

preserved_limits_and_failures: No source guard, resource cap, failed admission, prior failed campaign or historical receipt is waived. Source review does not establish host locking/fsync support.
